title: AI Document Extractor
summary: PDFs and emails become structured rows in Google Sheets, with expiry alerts and human review for uncertain fields.
problem: Teams tracked insurance certificates and invoices by hand and often missed expiry and due dates.
solution: An LLM reads PDFs and emails, writes fields to Google Sheets, deterministic code sets expiry status and sends reminder emails, and low-confidence items are flagged for human review. Also shipped an n8n workflow version for no-code teams.

zh.title: AI 文档提取器
zh.summary: PDF 和邮件变成 Google 表格里的结构化行，带到期提醒，不确定的字段交给人复核。
zh.problem: 保险凭证和发票靠人工抄进表格，到期日和付款日常常漏掉。
zh.solution: 大模型读 PDF 和邮件，把字段写进 Google 表格；到期状态和提醒邮件由普通代码决定，不交给模型；没把握的字段标出来给人复核。另外做了一版 n8n 工作流，给不写代码的团队用。
